text: “Her medicine!” “Do you mean that the murderer introduced the strychnine into her tonic?” I cried. “There was no need to introduce it. It was already there—in the mixture. The strychnine that killed Mrs. Inglethorp was the identical strychnine prescribed by Dr. Wilkins. To make that clear to you, I will read you an extract from a book on dispensing which I found in the Dispensary of the Red Cross Hospital at Tadminster: “‘The following prescription has become famous in text books: Strychninae Sulph.
